{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of internal test orders: {len(internal_orders)}")

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders from completed orders
df_filtered = df_completed[~df_completed.index.isin(internal_orders.index)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")

# Return total_revenue for submission
total_revenue"}
